item.title: Rising memory costs may push mobile prices up 30%, could trigger second-hand device market: Jefferies
item.description: Rising memory costs, driven by growing demand from the artificial intelligence industry, could push prices of low-end smartphones up by around 30 per cent and force consumers to delay fresh purchases or opt for second-hand devices, according to a report by Jefferies.

item.title: GIGABYTE 40th anniversary campaign launched in India: How to win rewards worth up to ₹15,500
item.description: GIGABYTE has launched its 40th anniversary ENTER INFINITY India campaign, offering gamers and PC builders Amazon gift vouchers worth up to ₹15,500, AORUS merchandise and GIGABYTE monitors.

item.title: What is Hangang? South Korea unveils a $276 million supercomputer with 614.7 petaflops of computing power
item.description: South Korea has launched Hangang, a $276 million national supercomputer equipped with 8,496 Nvidia GPUs and 614.7 petaflops of computing power. Designed to accelerate AI and scientific research, the system is expected to rank among the world's top 10 supercomputers.

item.title: Sony PS5 trade-in offer: US gamers can get up to $400 for old consoles ahead of GTA 6 launch; check details
item.description: Sony is offering US gamers up to $400 in cash for trading in their old PlayStation 5 consoles through a partnership with refurbished electronics marketplace Back Market, according to TweakTown. The offer could help players upgrade to the $899.99 PS5 Pro ahead of the much-anticipated GTA 6 launch.

item.title: AI moves beyond recommendations to reshape entire shopping experience on e-commerce apps: Report
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the way e-commerce applications personalise the shopping experience, moving beyond conventional product recommendations to potentially influence the entire interface customers see when they open an app, according to an industry report by AppMaker.

item.title: Realme 17T 5G live images reveal redesigned camera module and slimmer bezels ahead of launch
item.description: Realme 17T 5G live images have surfaced online, revealing a redesigned rear camera module and slimmer display bezels ahead of its expected launch. The smartphone is expected to succeed the Realme 16T 5G and join the upcoming Realme 17 series as a more affordable offering.

item.title: 87% of organisations face threat-related incidents, preparedness gaps persist: McKinsey
item.description: Around 87 per cent of organisations experienced at least one threat-related incident in the 24 months preceding a survey, but many remain inadequately prepared to deal with risks beyond conventional cybersecurity, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

item.title: PS5 console Black Friday deals 2026: Sony announces game discounts, hardware offers remain unconfirmed
item.description: Sony's PlayStation Black Friday Sale 2026 began on November 4, offering up to 75% off thousands of PS5, PS4 and PS VR2 games, with discounts running until November 30. The sale preview includes 16 titles, while deals on PS5 consoles, controllers and other accessories are yet to be announced.

item.title: Dell 14S laptop debuts in India with Intel Core 5, Core 7 processors: Price, features, specifications
item.description: Dell has launched the 14S laptop in India at a starting price of ₹79,990, with four colour options. It features Intel Series 3 Core 5 and Core 7 processors, up to 16GB of RAM, 1TB of storage and a display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate.

item.title: Mahesh Babu invests in Indian gaming startup Shortgun Games: What we know about the deal and its funding history
item.description: Mahesh Babu has acquired a minority stake in Indian gaming studio Shortgun Games for an undisclosed amount. The investment follows its $1 million seed round in 2025 as the company works on a PC and console game targeting global markets.

item.title: MeitY unveils indigenous AI Models EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and 5B under IndiaAI mission
item.description: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has unveiled three indigenous artificial intelligence foundation models, EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B, developed by domestic companies with support under the IndiaAI Mission, with the government highlighting their potential for specialised applications and deployment in secure, offline environments.

item.title: OnePlus Turbo 7 tipped to launch in December with Snapdragon 8 Gen 6, 200MP camera and 185Hz display
item.description: OnePlus Turbo 7 is tipped to launch in China in December 2026, powered by Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 chipset. The smartphone could feature a 200MP primary camera, a 185Hz display and a glass back, but may skip a periscope telephoto camera.

item.title: Why SIM-binding mandate is concern for consumers, MSMEs, and cybersecurity, a new study decodes
item.description: The Esya Centre study finds that India's proposed SIM-binding mandate could disrupt consumers and MSMEs, increase business costs and offer limited cybersecurity benefits, leaving phishing, malware and other cyber fraud risks largely unaddressed.

item.title: Indian companies trust AI with greater autonomy but struggle to prove financial returns: Report
item.description: Indian companies are increasingly allowing artificial intelligence (AI) systems to independently handle business processes, with 28 per cent of surveyed business leaders saying generative AI completes defined tasks from beginning to end without routine human approval.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra could get new camera design and upgraded privacy display: What we know
item.description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra could feature a redesigned camera bar for better compatibility with magnetic accessories, according to a new leak. The Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra are also tipped to get an upgraded Privacy Display with improved brightness.

item.title: Vivo Y32 5G launched with 8,000mAh battery, 120Hz display and 2TB expandable storage
item.description: Vivo Y32 5G has been unveiled with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor, a 6.87-inch 120Hz display and an 8,000mAh battery. The smartphone supports 44W fast charging, reverse charging and microSD storage expansion of up to 2TB.

item.title: Ukraine's 280-g drone detector intercepts real-time video feeds from Russian Molniya UAVs
item.description: Ukraine-based CODE380 has developed the D·Vision SDR, a 280-gram receiver that intercepts live camera feeds from Russian drones in real time. The device scans frequencies between 500 MHz and 8.7 GHz, helping Ukrainian forces monitor drone movements and identify potential targets before attacks.

item.title: AI must move beyond intelligence to offer wiser, ethical advice: Experts at IIT Ropar
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) must evolve beyond providing information to offering responsible, ethical and wiser advice, as growing dependence on the technology raises concerns over misleading responses, human decision-making and societal well-being, experts said.

item.title: Nothing OS 5.0 update based on Android 17, AI app builder, new Glyph features: Check rollout timeline, how to download
item.description: Nothing is expanding the stable rollout of Nothing OS 5.0, based on Android 17, to the Phone (4a) Pro, Phone (4a), Phone (3a) Pro and Phone (3a). The update adds interface and personalization changes, performance improvements and AI-powered tools. Availability is phased by device, region &amp; carrier.

item.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 players can claim free outfits, gold bars and Halloween rewards before November 4 deadline
item.description: Rockstar Games has introduced limited-time rewards and boosted payouts in Red Dead Online as part of its Halloween event. However, the offers do not include a free download of the full Red Dead Redemption 2 game.

item.title: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026: ASUS ExpertBook business laptops start at ₹50,990 with up to ₹18,000 off
item.description: ASUS ExpertBook business laptops are available with discounts of up to ₹18,000 during the Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026. Prices start at ₹50,990. Buyers can also get bank discounts of up to ₹10,000, exchange benefits of up to ₹15,000 and up to 12-month no-cost EMI.

item.title: Pebble Qore Vox brings AI meeting notes to your wrist: Check price, features and battery life
item.description: Pebble has launched the Qore Vox screenless wellness band in India at an introductory price of ₹5,799, combining health tracking with voice recording and AI-powered meeting summaries.

item.title: Redmi M100 Pro launched with Dimensity 7300-Ultra, 50MP camera and 5,500mAh battery: Check price
item.description: Xiaomi has launched the Redmi M100 Pro in China at CNY 2,499 (approximately ₹33,000), featuring the MediaTek Dimensity 7300-Ultra chipset and 12GB RAM. The smartphone sports a 6.67-inch 1.5K 120Hz OLED display, a 50-megapixel triple rear camera setup and a 5,500mAh battery with 45W wired charging.
